robot-garden.title: Robot Garden
robot-garden.prompt: A friendly rounded mint-green robot with a glossy shell stands on the right side of a wooden rooftop garden deck at sunrise, facing a terracotta pot holding one tall blooming sunflower. The robot tips a small copper watering can, sparkling droplets fall onto the soil, and the sunflower's petals brighten as it drinks. A gentle camera push-in moves toward the flower. Potted herbs line a wooden railing, hazy Parisian rooftops glow in the background, warm golden light with soft shadows, polished 3D animated film look.
robot-garden.note: Re-rendered with LTX-2.3 on 2026-10-13 so the clip matches the Gemini key-art poster (rooftop deck, copper watering can, sunflower push-in). The original CogVideoX 1.5 render is backed up at outputs/robot-garden-cogvideox-backup.mp4.
